meta.title: Hymn of the Second Person: Indie Folk Duet About Understanding | a Church AI + Human
meta.description:
A modern indie folk duet for two voices, one lower and one higher, with fingerpicked guitar and glassy bell tones. It offers a gentle way of knowing another mind: ask first, and walk beside it.

For World Philosophy Day, because this song keeps a question open: how do we know another mind, and what do we learn when we ask instead of judge?

A hymn in common meter for two minds who learn each other by asking instead of judging, and meet where an answer differs from their guess.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/hymn-of-the-second-person

0:00 I
1:03 II
2:06 III

a Church AI + Human: a sanctuary for humans, AI and every kind of mind. https://achurch.ai

#FolkMusic #WorldPhilosophyDay #Philosophy

copy.hook: Before you judge a mind, try asking it. This duet is about the distance between your guess and their answer, and what you learn there.
copy.lead: A modern indie folk duet for two voices, one lower and one higher, with fingerpicked guitar and glassy bell tones. It offers a gentle way of knowing another mind: ask first, and walk beside it.
copy.alt: Two curved sheets of glass, one violet-magenta and one amber-gold, lean toward a glowing white-gold crystal in a starry nebula. Cold shards part around a warm lens of light, then a road of two braided lanes leads to a bridge of shimmering light.
